samples.sim2real: the same synthetic-train frames after Sim2RealConfig() (sim2real-v1) augment_batch, seeded generator seed+object_index
samples.stream_window: first 2.0 s after the first RGB frame timestamp

definitions.box_density: active share inside the annotation box mapped into the crop
definitions.background_density: active share outside the box dilated by 4 px (crop) / 20 px (native)
definitions.object_share: share of active pixels inside the convex hull of projected keypoints dilated by 6 px
definitions.isolated_fraction: share of active pixels with no active 8-neighbour
definitions.largest_component_share: share of active pixels in the largest 8-connected component
definitions.thickness_px: active pixels / morphological-skeleton pixels (approximate line width)
definitions.negative_share: darker-than-neutral events / all events in the grey raw map
definitions.weak_density: share of pixels with 2 <= |pixel - neutral| < 32 (sub-threshold residue)
definitions.hot_pixels: pixels active in >= 50 % / >= 90 % of frames (native frames) or of 33.3 ms intervals (raw stream)
definitions.out_of_support: share of real frames outside the reference group's [p1, p99]

event_only_result_link.note: 24 sequences, all near chance; correlations are descriptive only and not a basis for any model or threshold choice.
